our_claim: Phi is completely monotone; e^{M r}Phi(r) is CM iff a positive measure supported in [M,infinity) exists. Equality M=inf supp nu is an additional condition.
nearest_prior_work: Bernstein-Widder; Bachas 1986 (concavity of V from reflection positivity)
overlap: Complete monotonicity of a Laplace transform is Bernstein-Widder. Bachas already derives two alternating-sign derivative conditions on the static potential from reflection positivity alone.

novelty_survives: NO as mathematics; YES only as the observation that this particular observable is CM.
evidence: Verified to n=3 numerically; counterexamples in the manuscript separate CM from H3.
required_rewording: Must not claim to strengthen Bachas. Must state that H3 is an additional assumption not derived here from reflection positivity.

our_claim: For the resummed bubble chain with a positive matter density, H3 reduces to the sign of Z3 = 1 - g^2 int rho/s: it holds for Z3 > 0, fails for Z3 < 0 through a spacelike pole of negative residue, and fails at Z3 = 0 through an additive constant 1/mu when the total mass is finite. With a hard cutoff and a density nonzero at the edge, the resummed measure carries one atom of positive weight above the cutoff for Z3 > 0. The continuum density is non-negative for every coupling, so continuum-moment tests cannot detect the Z3 < 0 failure.
claim_type: CONDITIONAL THEOREM (MODEL) + SCOPE LIMIT OF A DIAGNOSTIC
